extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism ontology record; automated placeholder mechanism notes were replaced with source-located direct and contextual claims.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: RNase 7 directly disrupts uropathogen cell-envelope integrity in the source-reviewed AFM experiment.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: recombinant RNase 7 tested against E. coli, P. aeruginosa, and E. faecalis

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=9:RNase 7 disrupts the microbial cell membrane of uropathogenic bacteria

mechanism_claims.limitations: Direct membrane-disruption evidence is morphological; no single molecular target is assigned.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: RNase 7 rapidly kills tested uropathogens with membrane-damage readouts in Live/Dead and confocal microscopy assays.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: recombinant RNase 7 against E. coli PEDUTI-89 and E. faecalis PEDUTI-983
mechanism_claims.limitations: The fluorescence/confocal assays support bactericidal membrane damage and neutralization by antibody; they do not quantify a biochemical binding target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: RNase 7 is part of urinary tract epithelial defense, with infection-associated expression and urinary peptide increases supporting host-defense context.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: human urinary tract RNase 7 expression and secretion

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=6:RNase 7 is secreted into the urine, and urinary levels of RNase 7 peptide increase with infection

mechanism_claims.limitations: Expression/localization evidence is contextual host-defense evidence, not a direct antimicrobial mechanism assay by itself.
